title: F2 turns Edit the words on and off from anywhere and freezes the raid while it is on
why: His order (2026-10-18): "add a toggle key for text editing mode so that I can edit text at anytime e.g middle of a raid. ... ideally when I click it the game would pause too so whatever is on screen stays there for me to modify". F2 now turns Edit the words on and off from anywhere (title, menus, the Undercroft, a raid), on this machine only like the Settings row, and it is the same one setting as that row (the key is the row click, so the row, the key, the profile and the tag cannot disagree). It is an edge press (a held key does not toggle twice), taken ahead of every other key listener so it never reaches the game as anything else, and F2 cannot be bound to an action. In a raid the mode freezes the world, the enemies, the raid clock and the bleed-out through the existing pause (G.paused, set by syncPause) without opening the pause box, so the HUD stays exactly as it was and a click on any string finds it; turning it off carries on with every key and the mouse button let go. A small plate top left says edit words: on (f2), clear of the upper right corner, and a short toast says on or off. In a shared raid it is the pause box rule: this window player stands still and the world runs on for the others until every window is paused. Also: a word edited in the 2 player demo is now kept (the demo profile is a sandbox that was thrown away at leave).
now: F2 turns the word editor on and off from anywhere. In a raid it freezes the game so you can click and edit any text, and F2 again carries on.
